## define helper functions
```{r define_functions}
PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS <- 2
  get_cheminfo_from_search <- function(search_list)
  {
    cheminfo <- ctxR::chemical_equal_batch(word_list=search_list)
    cheminfo <- subset(cheminfo, !is.na(searchValue))[,c("searchValue", "dtxsid", "casrn", "preferredName")]
    colnames(cheminfo) <- c("searchValue","DTXSID", "CAS", "Compound")
    return(cheminfo)
  }
  
  tkstats.log <- function(this.data, 
                          label, 
                          num.chems.with.data=NULL,
                          epsilon = 1e-7)
  {
    this.data <- subset(this.data, 
                        !is.infinite(Observed) &
                          !is.na(Observed) & 
                          !is.nan(log10(Observed + epsilon)))
    # Limit to chemicals with predictions:
    this.data <- subset(this.data, 
                          !is.na(Predicted) &
                          !is.nan(log10(Predicted + epsilon))
    )
    this.data <- subset(this.data,
                        !duplicated(this.data))
    if (nrow(this.data)>0)
    {
      this.fit <- lm(log10(this.data$Observed + epsilon) ~ 
                       log10(this.data$Predicted + epsilon), 
                     this.data)
      
      num.chems.with.preds <- length(unique(this.data$cichem))
      num.points <- nrow(this.data)
      frac.ten <- signif(sum(abs(log10(this.data$Observed/this.data$Predicted)) <
                               1, na.rm=TRUE) /
                           num.points, 3) 
      frac.three <- signif(sum(abs(log10(this.data$Observed/this.data$Predicted)) <
                                 log10(3), na.rm=TRUE) /
                             num.points, 3) 
      rmsle <- signif(mean(log10((this.data$Observed + epsilon) /
                                   (this.data$Predicted + epsilon))^2,
                           na.rm=TRUE)^(1/2),
                      3)
      msd <- signif(mean(log10((this.data$Observed + epsilon) /
                                   (this.data$Predicted + epsilon)),
                           na.rm=TRUE),
                      3)
      mod.summary <- summary(this.fit)
      rsquared <- signif(mod.summary$adj.r.squared, 3)
      f.stats <- mod.summary$fstatistic
      p.value <- signif(pf(f.stats[1], f.stats[2], f.stats[3], lower.tail = FALSE),
                        3)
      if (p.value < 1e-6) p.value <- "<10-6"
      
      return(data.frame(Parameter = label,
                        Num.Chems.with.Data = ifelse(is.null(num.chems.with.data),
                                                     num.chems.with.preds,
                                                     num.chems.with.data),
                        Num.Chems.with.Preds = num.chems.with.preds,
                        Num.Obs = num.points,
                        Within.Ten = frac.ten,
                        Within.Three = frac.three,
                        RMSLE = rmsle,
                        MSD = msd,
                        RSquared = rsquared
                        ))
    } else return(
      data.frame(Parameter = label,
                        Num.Chems.with.Data = ifelse(is.null(num.chems.with.data),
                                                     num.chems.with.preds,
                                                     num.chems.with.data),
                        Num.Chems.with.Preds = num.chems.with.preds,
                        Num.Obs = num.points,
                 Within.Ten = 0,
                 Within.Three = 0,
                 RMSLE = NA,
                 MSD = NA,
                 RSquared = NA)
    )
  }
  
  tkstats.alg <- function(this.data, label,
                          num.chems.with.data=NULL)
  {
    this.data <- subset(this.data, 
                        !is.infinite(Observed) &
                          !is.na(Observed) & 
                          !is.nan(Observed))
    # Limit to chemicals with predictions:
    this.data <- subset(this.data, 
                          !is.na(Predicted) &
                          !is.nan(Predicted))
    this.data <- subset(this.data,
                    !duplicated(this.data))
    this.fit <- lm(Observed ~ Predicted, 
                   this.data)
    
    num.chems.with.preds <- length(unique(this.data$cichem))
    num.points <- nrow(this.data)
    frac.ten <- signif(sum(abs(log10(this.data$Observed/this.data$Predicted)) <
                             1, na.rm=TRUE) /
                         num.points, 3) 
    frac.three <- signif(sum(abs(log10(this.data$Observed/this.data$Predicted)) <
                               log10(3), na.rm=TRUE) /
                           num.points, 3) 
    rmse <- signif(mean((this.data$Observed - this.data$Predicted)^2,
                        na.rm=TRUE)^(1/2),
                   3)
    msd <- signif(mean((this.data$Observed - this.data$Predicted),
                        na.rm=TRUE),
                   3)
    mod.summary <- summary(this.fit)
    rsquared <- signif(mod.summary$adj.r.squared, 3)
    f.stats <- mod.summary$fstatistic
    p.value <- signif(pf(f.stats[1], f.stats[2], f.stats[3], lower.tail = FALSE),
                      3)
    if (p.value < 1e-6) p.value <- "<10-6"
    
    return(data.frame(Parameter = label,
                        Num.Chems.with.Data = ifelse(is.null(num.chems.with.data),
                                                     num.chems.with.preds,
                                                     num.chems.with.data),
                        Num.Chems.with.Preds = num.chems.with.preds,
                      Num.Obs = num.points,
                      Within.Ten = frac.ten,
                      Within.Three = frac.three,
                      RMSE = rmse,
                      MSD = msd,
                      RSquared = rsquared))
  }
```

# TK Data Landscape
## Landscape Matrix
```{r create_landscape_matrix}
  NA.vec <- rep(NA, length(rocks$cichem_id))
  NA.mat <- NA.vec
  for (i in 2:length(unique(db.coverage$Parameter)))
  {
    NA.mat <- cbind(NA.mat, NA.vec)
  }
  
  httk.params.mat <- data.frame(NA.mat)
  colnames(httk.params.mat) <- unique(db.coverage$Parameter)
  rownames(httk.params.mat) <- rocks$cichem_id
  
  for (this.param in unique(db.coverage$Parameter))
  {
    httk.params.mat[,this.param] <- 3 # "OutOfDomain"
    httk.params.mat[rocks$cichem_id %in% subset(db.coverage,
                                          Parameter == this.param &
                                            Type == "Predicted" &
                                            !is.na(Value))$cichem,
                    this.param] <- 2 # "QSPR"
    httk.params.mat[all.rocks.chems %in% subset(db.coverage,
                                          Parameter == this.param &
                                            Type == "Measured" &
                                            !is.na(Value))$cichem,
                    this.param] <- 1 # "Measured"
  }

  tk.landscape.mat <- cbind(NA.vec,NA.vec,NA.vec,NA.vec)
  tk.landscape.mat[] <- 0
  colnames(tk.landscape.mat) <- c("In Vivo",
                                  "In Vitro",
                                  "QSPR",
                                  "IVIVE")
  rownames(tk.landscape.mat) <- rocks$cichem_id
  # In vivo TK data (for example, human half-life) are available:
  tk.landscape.mat[invivodata, "In Vivo"] <- 1
  # QSPR predicted in vitro TK parameters (fup, Clint, etc.) are available:
  tk.landscape.mat[subset(httkdata,
                          Type == "Predicted" &
                            !is.na(Value))$cichem,
                   "QSPR"] <- 1
  # Measured In vitro TK parameters (for example, Wetmore 2015) are available:
  tk.landscape.mat[subset(httkdata,
                          Type == "Measured" &
                            !is.na(Value))$cichem,
                   "In Vitro"] <- 1
  # A Css value is available:
  tk.landscape.mat[subset(ivivedata,
                          !is.na(Value) &
                            Parameter == "Css")$cichem,
                   "IVIVE"] <- 1
  # Dawson (2023) ML model used:
  tk.landscape.mat[subset(ivivedata,
                          Model == "pfas1compartment" &
                            Parameter == "Css" &
                            !is.na(Value))$cichem,
                   "QSPR"] <- 1
```

# Figure 4, Half-life Sources
```{r create_halflife_by_source_figure}
  use.table <- read.csv("data/rocks_sector_table_2026-08-27.csv")
  cheminfo <- read.csv("data/rocks_sector_table_2026-08-27.csv")
  # Check for chemicals with no known use:
  any(apply(cheminfo, 1, function(x) all(x[c("consumer","food","industrial","agricultural","pharmaceutical")]==0)))
  cheminfo$unknown <- 0
  cheminfo[cheminfo$sector_class %in% "Unknown","unknown"] <- 1
  
  cheminfo <- pivot_longer(cheminfo, cols=c("consumer","food","industrial","agricultural","pharmaceutical", "unknown"))
  cheminfo <- subset(cheminfo, value == 1)
  
  cheminfo$TK <- "No Predictions"
  cheminfo[cheminfo$cichem_id %in% rownames(subset(tk.landscape.mat,
                                                   tk.landscape.mat[,"QSPR"]==1)),
           "TK"] <- "QSPR"
  cheminfo[cheminfo$cichem_id %in% rownames(subset(tk.landscape.mat,
                                       tk.landscape.mat[,"In Vitro"]==1)),
           "TK"] <- "In Vitro"
  cheminfo[cheminfo$cichem_id %in% rownames(subset(tk.landscape.mat,
                                                   tk.landscape.mat[,"In Vivo"]==1)),
           "TK"] <- "In Vivo"
  cheminfo$Use <- factor(cheminfo$name)
  cheminfo$TK <- factor(cheminfo$TK, levels=c("In Vivo","In Vitro","QSPR","No Predictions"))
  Fig4 <- ggplot(cheminfo, aes(x=Use, fill=TK))+
    geom_bar(position="dodge")+
    scale_fill_manual(values = UL.cols) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = label_log()) +
    labs(y= "Number of Chemicals", x="Use Sector")+
    theme_pubr()
  print(Fig4)
  
  png("figs/Fig4.png", height = 600, width = 1000)
  print(Fig4 + theme_pubr(base_size = 24))
  dev.off()
```

# Table of measured in vivo human TK parameters
```{r human_invivo_hl_table}
  usesectors<- read.csv("data/rocks_sector_table_2026-08-27.csv")
  all.invivo.data <- query_invivodb(all.human.invivo.chems, search.col="cichem")
  
  
  css.invivo.data <- query_ivivedb(all.human.invivo.chems, search.col="cichem",
                                      uncertainty = NA,
                                      variability = NA)
  css.invivo.data <- subset(css.invivo.data, Route %in% "oral")
  css.invivo.data <- subset(css.invivo.data, Species %in% "Human")
  css.invivo.data <- subset(css.invivo.data, Model %in% "in vivo")
  
  all.invivo.data <- all.invivo.data[,c("cichem", 
  "Parameter", "Value", "Units", "DTXSID", "CASRN", "Compound", 
  "Reference", "PMID", "Species")]
  all.invivo.data <- rbind(all.invivo.data,
                           css.invivo.data[,colnames(all.invivo.data)])
  all.invivo.data <- subset(all.invivo.data, Species %in% "Human")
  all.invivo.data <- merge(all.invivo.data, usesectors, by.x="cichem", by.y="cichem_id")
  all.invivo.data$Value <- signif(as.numeric(all.invivo.data$Value), 4)
  all.invivo.data <- subset(all.invivo.data,
                            !is.infinite(Value) &
                              Value > 0)
  
  hl.invivo.data <- subset(all.invivo.data, Parameter=="halflife")
  
```

# Supplemental Table Use Sector Trends with TK Stats
```{r create_use_sector_trends_table}
tk.and.use.table <- NULL  
tk.and.use.trend.table <- NULL
all.invivo.data$Bin <- NA
for (this.param in c("halflife", "Vdist", "Cltot", "Css", "Foral"))
{
  these.rows <- all.invivo.data$Parameter == this.param
    if (this.param != "Foral")
    {
      all.invivo.data[these.rows, "Bin"] <- cut(
        log10(all.invivo.data[these.rows, "Value"]),
        10, labels=FALSE)
    } else {
      all.invivo.data[these.rows, "Bin"] <- cut(
        all.invivo.data[these.rows, "Value"],
        10, labels=FALSE)
    } 
    for (this.bin in 1:10)
    {
      these.data <- subset(all.invivo.data,
                           these.rows &
                             Bin == this.bin)
      N.tot <- nrow(these.data)
      this.row <- data.frame(Parameter = this.param,
                             N.tot = N.tot,
                             Bin.Median = median(these.data$Value),
                             Frac_Consumer = 
                               nrow(subset(these.data, consumer==1))/N.tot,
                             Frac_Food = 
                               nrow(subset(these.data, food==1))/N.tot,
                             Frac_Industrial = 
                               nrow(subset(these.data, industrial==1))/N.tot,
                             Frac_Agricultural = 
                               nrow(subset(these.data, agricultural==1))/N.tot,
                             Frac_Pharmaceutical = 
                               nrow(subset(these.data, pharmaceutical==1))/N.tot
      )
      tk.and.use.table <- rbind(tk.and.use.table, this.row)
    }

  for (this.use in c("Consumer", "Food", "Industrial", "Agricultural", "Pharmaceutical"))
  {
    if (this.param != "Foral")
    {
      this.stats <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste0("Frac_", this.use," ~ log10(Bin.Median)")), 
                        weights=N.tot, 
                        data=subset(tk.and.use.table,
                                    Parameter == this.param)
        ))
    } else {
      this.stats <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste0("Frac_", this.use," ~ Bin.Median")), 
                        weights=N.tot, 
                        data=subset(tk.and.use.table,
                                    Parameter == this.param)
        ))
    }
    this.row <- data.frame(
      Parameter = this.param,
      Use = this.use,
      Trend = ifelse(this.stats$coefficients[2,1]>0,
                     "Increases",
                     "Decreases"),
      Fold.Change = subset(tk.and.use.table,
                                    Parameter == this.param)$Bin.Median[10]/
        subset(tk.and.use.table,
                                    Parameter == this.param)$Bin.Median[1],
      Rsquared = signif(this.stats$r.squared,3),
      pValue = signif(this.stats$coefficients[2,4],3)
      )
    tk.and.use.trend.table <- rbind(tk.and.use.trend.table, this.row)
  }
}

write.table(tk.and.use.trend.table[order(tk.and.use.trend.table[,"pValue"]),],
            file="tables/SupTableX-UseTrends.txt",
            sep="\t",
            row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r create_use_with_halflife_Figure}
  time.points <- c(0,10^(seq(-1,6.5,0.5)))
  hl.invivo.data$Bin <- cut(as.numeric(hl.invivo.data$Value), 
                            breaks=time.points, labels=FALSE)
  BinLimits <- sort(unique(cut(as.numeric(hl.invivo.data$Value), 
                               breaks=time.points)))
  BinCenter <- lapply(strsplit(gsub("]","",
                                    gsub("\\(","",as.character(BinLimits))),","), 
                      function(x) mean(as.numeric(x)))
  BinLeft <- lapply(strsplit(gsub("]","",
                                  gsub("\\(","",as.character(BinLimits))),","), 
                    function(x) as.numeric(x[1]))
  BinRight <- lapply(strsplit(gsub("]","",
                                   gsub("\\(","",as.character(BinLimits))),","), 
                     function(x) as.numeric(x[2]))

  hl.and.use <- NULL
  for (this.bin in sort(unique(hl.invivo.data$Bin)))
  {
    these.chems <- subset(hl.invivo.data, Bin %in% this.bin)
    N.tot <- nrow(these.chems)
    this.row <- data.frame(Bin = this.bin,
                           N.tot = N.tot,
                           "Half-Life" = BinCenter[[this.bin]],
                           Frac_Consumer = nrow(subset(these.chems, consumer==1))/N.tot,
                           Frac_Food = nrow(subset(these.chems, food==1))/N.tot,
                           Frac_Industrial = nrow(subset(these.chems, industrial==1))/N.tot,
                           Frac_Agricultural = nrow(subset(these.chems, agricultural==1))/N.tot,
                           Frac_Pharmaceutical = nrow(subset(these.chems, pharmaceutical==1))/N.tot
    )
    hl.and.use <- rbind(hl.and.use, this.row)
  }
  hl.and.use[hl.and.use$Bin == 1, "Half.Life"] <- min(hl.invivo.data$Value)
    
  hl.and.use <- pivot_longer(hl.and.use, cols=c("Frac_Consumer","Frac_Food","Frac_Industrial","Frac_Agricultural","Frac_Pharmaceutical"))
```

```{r create_use_with_halflife_Figure}
#  time.points <- c(0,1/60,1,4,8,12,24,7*24,30*24,365*24,3*365*24,10*365*24,30*365*24,100*365*24)
  time.points <- c(0,10^(seq(-1,6.5,0.5)))
  hl.invivo.data$Bin <- cut(as.numeric(hl.invivo.data$Value), 
                            breaks=time.points, labels=FALSE)
  BinLimits <- sort(unique(cut(as.numeric(hl.invivo.data$Value), 
                               breaks=time.points)))
  BinCenter <- lapply(strsplit(gsub("]","",
                                    gsub("\\(","",as.character(BinLimits))),","), 
                      function(x) mean(as.numeric(x)))
  BinLeft <- lapply(strsplit(gsub("]","",
                                  gsub("\\(","",as.character(BinLimits))),","), 
                    function(x) as.numeric(x[1]))
  BinRight <- lapply(strsplit(gsub("]","",
                                   gsub("\\(","",as.character(BinLimits))),","), 
                     function(x) as.numeric(x[2]))
  
  hl.time.limits <-c(1/120/60, 365*24*100)
  hl.time.breaks <- c(1/60/60,1/60,1,24,7*24,30*24,365*24,365*24*10)
  hl.time.labels <- c("Second","Minute", "Hour", "Day", "Week", "Month", "Year","Decade")
  
  # Normalize bins to reduce confusion:
  for (this.bin in unique(hl.and.use$Bin))
  {
    bin.norm <- sum(subset(hl.and.use, Bin%in% this.bin)$value)
    hl.and.use[hl.and.use$Bin %in% this.bin,"value.norm"] <-
      signif(hl.and.use[hl.and.use$Bin %in% this.bin,"value"] / bin.norm, 3)
    # Clean up rounding errors:
    bin.total <- sum(subset(hl.and.use, Bin%in% this.bin)$value.norm)
    hl.and.use[hl.and.use$Bin %in% this.bin & 
                 hl.and.use$name %in% "Frac_Industrial", "value.norm"] <-
    hl.and.use[hl.and.use$Bin %in% this.bin & 
                 hl.and.use$name %in% "Frac_Industrial", "value.norm"] +
      1-bin.total
  }
  
  Fig2old <- ggplot(hl.and.use, aes(x=Half.Life, y=value.norm, fill=name)) + 
    geom_area()+
    scale_fill_manual(name="Use Sector",
```

```{r create_shortlong_halflife_table}
  hl.sup.table <- subset(hl.invivo.data,

                              "Species", "Parameter", "Value", "Units",
                              "Reference", "consumer",
                              "food", "industrial", "agricultural",

                              "biomonitoring", "sector_class", "Bin")],
              file="tables/SupTableX-FastestandLongestHL.txt",

  cat(paste0("The chemicals with the longest half-lives with food use are ",
             paste(subset(max.hl, food==1)$Compound, collapse=" and "),
             ".\n"))
```

```{r determine_valid_httk_chems}
con <- duckdb::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(), 
  dbdir = ivivedb, 
  read_only = FALSE)
qry <- paste0("
      SELECT DISTINCT cichem
      FROM CITK.invitroTK
  	  INNER JOIN CITK.chemicals ON invitroTK.chem_id_fk=chemicals.chem_id
      WHERE Parameter = 'Clint'
        AND Type = 'Measured';
      ")
clint.chems <- dbGetQuery(con, qry)  
qry <- paste0("
      SELECT DISTINCT cichem
      FROM CITK.invitroTK
  	  INNER JOIN CITK.chemicals ON invitroTK.chem_id_fk=chemicals.chem_id
      WHERE Parameter = 'Fup'
        AND Type = 'Measured';
      ")
fup.chems <- dbGetQuery(con, qry)  
duckdb::dbDisconnect(con)

all.httk.meas <- intersect(clint.chems, fup.chems)
any.httk.meas <- union(clint.chems, fup.chems)
valid.httk.chems <- unique(c(all.httk.allgoodqspr$cichem, all.httk.meas, all.httk.pfas))
```

# Supplemental table of invivo stats:
```{r invivo_table_stats}
con <- duckdb::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(), 
  dbdir = ivivedb, 
  read_only = FALSE)
invivo.table <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con,       
  "
  SELECT * 
  FROM CITK.invivo
  LEFT JOIN CITK.chemicals ON CITK.invivo.chem_id_fk = CITK.chemicals.chem_id;
  "
  )
invivo.table <- subset(invivo.table,
                       !is.na(Value) & 
                       !is.infinite(Value) &
                       !is.nan(log10(as.numeric(Value) + 1e-6)))

  httk.table <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con,       
  "
  SELECT *,
         Model
  FROM CITK.httk
  LEFT JOIN CITK.chemicals ON CITK.httk.chem_id_fk = CITK.chemicals.chem_id
  LEFT JOIN CITK.models ON CITK.httk.model_id_fk = CITK.models.model_id
  WHERE Model IN ('pfas1compartment', 'sumclearancesplus');
  "
  )                          
  httk.table <- subset(httk.table,
                       !is.na(Value) & 
                       !is.infinite(Value) &
                       !is.nan(log10(as.numeric(Value) + 1e-6)))

  css.table <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con,       
  "
  SELECT * 
  FROM CITK.ivive
  LEFT JOIN CITK.chemicals ON CITK.ivive.chem_id_fk = CITK.chemicals.chem_id
  LEFT JOIN CITK.models ON CITK.ivive.model_id_fk = CITK.models.model_id
  WHERE Model IN ('pfas1compartment', 'sumclearancesplus', 'in vivo');
  "
  )
  css.table <- subset(css.table,
                       !is.na(Value) & 
                       !is.infinite(Value) &
                       !is.nan(log10(as.numeric(Value) + 1e-6)))
  duckdb::dbDisconnect(con)
  
CITK.summary.table <- NULL
for (this.param in unique(invivo.table$Parameter))
{
  this.invivo.subset <- subset(invivo.table, Parameter %in% this.param)
  this.human.subset <- subset(this.invivo.subset, Species %in% "Human")
  this.nonhuman.subset <- subset(this.invivo.subset, !(Species %in% "Human"))
  this.pred.subset <- subset(httk.table, Parameter %in% this.param &
                               Type %in% "Predicted" &
                     cichem %in% valid.httk.chems)
  this.eval.chems <- unique(intersect(
                          this.human.subset$cichem,
                          this.pred.subset$cichem))
  this.eval.subset <- subset(this.human.subset, cichem %in% this.eval.chems)
  CITK.summary.table <-
    rbind(CITK.summary.table,
          data.frame(Parameter = this.param,
                         Num.ROCKS.Meas.Chems = sum(unique(
                           this.human.subset$cichem) %in% all.rocks.chems),
                        Num.Total.Meas.Chems = length(unique(
                           this.invivo.subset$cichem)),
                        Num.Obs = nrow(this.invivo.subset),
                        Num.Human.Meas.Chems = length(unique(
                           this.human.subset$cichem)),
                        Num.NonHuman.Meas.Chems = length(unique(
                          this.nonhuman.subset$cichem)),
                        Num.Pred.Chems = length(unique(
                           this.pred.subset$cichem)),
                        Num.Eval.Chems = length(this.eval.chems),
                        Num.Eval.Obs = nrow(this.eval.subset)
  ))
}
css.meas <- subset(css.table, Type %in% "Measured")
css.human <- subset(css.meas, Species %in% "Human")
css.nonhuman <- subset(css.meas, !(Species %in% "Human"))
css.pred <- subset(css.table, !is.na(Value) & Type %in% "Predicted" &
                     cichem %in% valid.httk.chems)
css.eval.chems <- unique(intersect(css.human$cichem, css.pred$cichem))
css.eval <- subset(css.meas, cichem %in% css.eval.chems)
css.row <- data.frame(Parameter = "Css",
                      Num.ROCKS.Meas.Chems = sum(unique(css.meas$cichem)
                                                 %in% all.rocks.chems),
                      Num.Total.Meas.Chems = length(unique(
                           css.meas$cichem)),
                      Num.Obs = nrow(this.invivo.subset),
                      Num.Human.Meas.Chems = length(unique(
                           css.human$cichem)),
                        Num.NonHuman.Meas.Chems = length(unique(
                          css.nonhuman$cichem)),
                        Num.Pred.Chems = length(unique(
                           css.pred$cichem)),
                        Num.Eval.Chems = length(css.eval.chems),
                        Num.Eval.Obs = nrow(css.eval)
) 
CITK.summary.table <- rbind(CITK.summary.table, css.row)

write.table(CITK.summary.table, file="tables/SupTableCITKCounts.txt", 
            row.names=FALSE,
            sep="\t")
```

```{r make_sankey_plot}
  geom_text(
            aes(label = node), 
            stat = "sankeynode", 
            position = pos_text, hjust = 0, cex = 14) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.2, .6)))+ 
  theme_pubr(base_size = 24)
```

# Supplemental Table Use and Predictions
```{r create_use_and_coverage_table}
  rocks.with.structure <- subset(rocks, 
                                 !(cichem_id %in% nostructure.chems))$dtxsid

  use.and.preds.table <- NULL
  for (this.use in unique(cheminfo$name))
  {
    this.subset <- subset(cheminfo, name %in% this.use)
    this.structure.subset <- subset(cheminfo, name %in% this.use & 
                                      dtxsid %in% rocks.with.structure)
    num.no.preds <- nrow(subset(this.subset, TK %in% "No Predictions"))
    num.no.preds.with.struct <- nrow(subset(this.structure.subset,
                                            TK %in% "No Predictions"))
    num.chems <- nrow(this.subset)
    num.struct.chems <- nrow(this.structure.subset)
    frac.no.structure <- signif((num.chems - num.struct.chems)/num.chems,
                                3)
    frac.no.pred <- signif(num.no.preds/num.chems,
      3)
    frac.struct.no.pred <- signif(num.no.preds.with.struct / num.struct.chems,
                                  3) 
    use.and.preds.table <- rbind(use.and.preds.table,
      data.frame(Use = this.use,
                 Num.Chems = num.chems,
                 Num.Chems.with.Structure = num.struct.chems,
                 Frac.No.Structure = frac.no.structure,
                 Frac.No.Pred = frac.no.pred,
                 Frac.with.Struct.but.No.Pred = frac.struct.no.pred)
    )
  }

  write.table(use.and.preds.table,
              file="tables/SupTableX-UseandPredCoverage.txt",
              row.names=FALSE,
              sep="\t")
  
  
cat(paste0(
  use.and.preds.table[which(use.and.preds.table$Num.Chems == max(use.and.preds.table$Num.Chems)),"Use"],
  " chemicals are the largest overall category and also have the fewest chemicals with HTTK predictions (",
  use.and.preds.table[which(use.and.preds.table$Num.Chems == max(use.and.preds.table$Num.Chems)),"Frac.No.Pred"]*100,
  " percent).\n"))

cat(paste0(
  signif(use.and.preds.table[use.and.preds.table=="industrial", "Frac.No.Structure"]*100, 
         PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
  "% of industrial chemicals have no structure and so could not be used with QSPR models.\n"))

cat(paste0("Among the industrial chemicals with structures, ",
  signif(use.and.preds.table[use.and.preds.table=="industrial", "Frac.with.Struct.but.No.Pred"]*100, PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
  "% of have no prediction (that is, were outside the AD of at least one QSPR model).\n"))


cat(paste0(
  use.and.preds.table[which(use.and.preds.table$Frac.No.Pred == min(use.and.preds.table$Frac.No.Pred)),"Use"],
    " chemicals are the best covered, with ",
    use.and.preds.table[which(use.and.preds.table$Frac.No.Pred == min(use.and.preds.table$Frac.No.Pred)),"Frac.No.Pred"]*100,
    " percent lacking predictions.\n"))
```

```{r chemical_class_analysis}
#  rocks.classy <- subset(all.pipeline.classy, cichem %in% rocks$cichem_id)
#  write_parquet(rocks.classy, "pipeline/rocks_classy.parquet")
  rocks.classy <- read_parquet("pipeline/rocks_classy.parquet")
  
  rocks.classy$TK <- "No Predictions"
  rocks.classy[rocks.classy$cichem %in% 
                 rownames(subset(tk.landscape.mat,
                                 tk.landscape.mat[,"QSPR"]==1)),
           "TK"] <- "QSPR"
  rocks.classy[rocks.classy$cichem %in% 
                 rownames(subset(tk.landscape.mat,
                                 tk.landscape.mat[,"In Vitro"]==1)),
           "TK"] <- "In Vitro"
  rocks.classy[rocks.classy$cichem %in% 
                 rownames(subset(tk.landscape.mat,
                                 tk.landscape.mat[,"In Vivo"]==1)),
           "TK"] <- "In Vivo"
  
  rocks.prevalence <- rocks.classy |> 
    group_by(class) |> 
    summarise(Num.Chems = n(), Prevalence = n()/nrow(rocks.classy)) |>
    arrange(desc(Prevalence))
  rocks.invitroTK.prevalence <- rocks.classy |> 
    filter(TK == "In Vitro") |>
    group_by(class) |> 
    summarise(Num.Chems = n(), Prevalence = n()/nrow(rocks.classy)) |>
    arrange(desc(Prevalence))
  rocks.noTK.prevalence <- rocks.classy |> 
    filter(TK == "No Predictions") |>
    group_by(class) |> 
    summarise(Num.Chems = n(), Prevalence = n()/nrow(rocks.classy)) |>
    arrange(desc(Prevalence))
  rocks.TK.prevalence <- rocks.classy |> 
    filter(TK != "No Predictions") |>
    group_by(class) |> 
    summarise(Num.Chems = n(), Prevalence = n()/nrow(rocks.classy)) |>
    arrange(desc(Prevalence))
  nrow(rocks.TK.prevalence)
  nrow(rocks.noTK.prevalence)
  # First seven the same in both
  # But many more classes with no TK
  TK.class <- rocks.TK.prevalence$class[1:10]
  TK.class <- TK.class[TK.class!=""]
  noTK.class <- rocks.noTK.prevalence$class[1:10]
  noTK.class <- noTK.class[noTK.class!=""]
  class.dif <- which(TK.class!=noTK.class)[1]
cat(paste0("The first ", class.dif-1,
    " most prevalent chemical classes are consistent between the chemicals\
with and without TK predictions: ",
    paste(TK.class[1:(class.dif-1)],collapse=", "),
    ".\n"))
cat(paste0("However, there are ",
           dim(rocks.noTK.prevalence)[1] - dim(rocks.TK.prevalence)[1],
           " more classes present among the chemicals with no TK predictions (see Supplemental Table X).\n"))
missing.TK.prevalance <- subset(rocks.noTK.prevalence,
                               !(class %in% rocks.TK.prevalence$class))
cat(paste0("The most prevalent classes not present are various classes of metallic compounds. The TK of metals may be very different from the organic and PFAS chemicals covered by the QSPRs [KENTUCKY REF].\n"))
```

# Evaluation of HTTK Predictions (Table 2)
```{r evaluate_httk}
get_tkparam_data <- function(con, param, num.meas.chems, log=TRUE)
{
  num.chems.meas <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT chem_id_fk) AS unique_count
  FROM CITK.invivo
  WHERE Parameter = '", param, "'
    AND Species ='Human';
  "))

  data.set <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("
         SELECT 
          chemicals.Compound,
          chemicals.DTXSID as DTXSID,
          chemicals.cichem as cichem,
          measured.Value as Observed,
          measured.Units,
          refs.Reference,
          predicted.Value as Predicted,
          predicted.HTTKBasis,
          Model
        FROM CITK.invivo as measured
        LEFT OUTER JOIN CITK.httk as predicted
          ON measured.chem_id_fk = predicted.chem_id_fk
        LEFT OUTER JOIN CITK.models
          ON predicted.model_id_fk = models.model_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN CITK.chemicals
          ON measured.chem_id_fk = chemicals.chem_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN CITK.refs
          ON measured.ref_id_fk = refs.ref_id
        WHERE measured.Parameter = '", param, "'
          AND measured.Species = 'Human'
          AND models.Model IN ('pfas1compartment', 'sumclearancesplus')
          AND predicted.Parameter = '", param, "'
          AND predicted.Species = 'Human'
          AND predicted.Type = 'Predicted';
    "))
  pfas1comp.chems <- subset(data.set, Model %in% "pfas1compartment")
  sumclear.chems <- subset(data.set, Model %in% "sumclearancesplus")
  onecomponly <- subset(pfas1comp.chems, !(cichem %in% sumclear.chems$cichem))
  data.set <- subset(data.set, Model %in% c(NA, "sumclearancesplus") | 
                 cichem %in% onecomponly)
  data.set <- subset(data.set, !duplicated(data.set))
  data.set <- subset(data.set, cichem %in% valid.httk.chems)
  data.set$Observed <- as.numeric(data.set$Observed)
  data.set$Predicted <- as.numeric(data.set$Predicted)

  this.plot <- ggplot(data.set, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted)) +
                      geom_point(alpha=0.05, size=3)+
    ggtitle(param)
  if (log) {
    this.plot <- this.plot +
      scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_log())+
      scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_log())
  }
  
  print(this.plot)
  png(paste0("figs/SupFigX-",
      param, 
      "-obspred.png"), 
    height = 900, 
    width = 800)
  print(this.plot+ theme_pubr(base_size = 24))
  dev.off()
  
  write.table(data.set,
              file=paste0("tables/SupTableX-",
                          param,
                          "data.txt"),
              sep="\t", 
              row.names=FALSE)

  return(list(
    data.set = data.set,
    num.chems.meas = num.chems.meas,
    this.plot = this.plot))
}

  duckdb::dbDisconnect(con)
  con <- duckdb::dbConnect(
    duckdb::duckdb(), 
    dbdir = ivivedb, 
    read_only = FALSE)
  
  out <- get_tkparam_data(con, "halflife")
  hl <- out$data.set
  hl.row <- tkstats.log(hl, "Half-Life", out[["num.chems.meas"]][[1]])

  out <- get_tkparam_data(con, "Vdist")
  vd <- out$data.set
  vd.row <- tkstats.log(vd, "Vdist", out[["num.chems.meas"]][[1]])

  out <- get_tkparam_data(con, "Foral")
  foral <- out$data.set
  foral.row <- tkstats.alg(foral, "Foral*", out[["num.chems.meas"]][[1]])

  out <- get_tkparam_data(con, "Cltot")
  cltot <- out$data.set
  cltot.row <- tkstats.log(cltot, "Cltot", out[["num.chems.meas"]][[1]])
  
  css.chems.meas <- length(unique(subset(css.data, Type == "Measured"))$cichem)
  css.row <- tkstats.log(css.data, "Css", css.chems.meas)
    

  # Close DB connection:
  duckdb::dbDisconnect(con)
```

# Supplemental Table with accuracy for long half-lives
```{r long_halflife_analysis}
hl.predgt1000 <- subset(hl, Predicted > 1000)
signif(sum(hl.predgt1000$Observed>1000)/nrow(hl.predgt1000)*100,
       PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS)

hl.quant.frac <- NULL
for (quant in sort(c(seq(0.05,0.97,0.05),seq(0.97,0.9975,0.0025))))
{
  this.observed.quant <- quantile(as.numeric(hl$Observed), quant)
  this.subset <- subset(hl, Observed >= this.observed.quant)
  this.frac.tenfold <- sum(abs(log10(this.subset$Predicted /
                        this.subset$Observed)) < 1, na.rm=TRUE)/nrow(this.subset)
  this.frac.over1000 <- sum(this.subset$Predicted > 
                                     1000, na.rm=TRUE)/nrow(this.subset)
  hl.quant.frac <- rbind(hl.quant.frac,
    data.frame(Quant.Prob=quant,
               Obs.Quant = this.observed.quant,
                  Num.Obs = nrow(this.subset),
                  Frac.Tenfold = signif(this.frac.tenfold, 3),
                  FRAC.Over1000 = signif(this.frac.over1000, 3))
  )
}
write.table(hl.quant.frac,
          file="tables/SupTableX-HLQuantileAccuracy.txt",
          row.names=FALSE,
```

```{r density_plot}
convert_to_fp_matrix <- function(x)
{
  mat <- x[, c("densmap_1", "densmap_2")]
  mat$densmap_1 <- as.numeric(mat$densmap_1)
  mat$densmap_2 <- as.numeric(mat$densmap_2)
  rownames(mat) <- x$cichem
  
  colnames(mat) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

  return(mat)  
}

kmeans_elbow <- function(x, label)
{ 
  wss.httk <- vapply(2:50, 
                 function(n_clusters) {
                   # luggage combination:
                   set.seed(12345)       
                   kmeans(x, 
                           centers = n_clusters, 
                           nstart = 5, 
                           iter.max = 100)$tot.withinss
                  }, 
                numeric(1))
  
  png(paste0("figs/SupFigX-ElbowPlot",
  label,
  ".png"), height = 600, width = 800)
  plot(2:50, wss.httk, type = "b", pch = 19, xlab = "Number of clusters k",
   ylab = "Total within-cluster sum of squares", 
   main = paste0(label," Targets Elbow plot"))
  dev.off()
}

library(data.table)

find_closest_to_centroid <- function(x, k, NUM.SELECT)
{
  x <- as.data.table(x, keep.rownames = TRUE)
  set.seed(12345)
  km_result <- kmeans(x[, c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")], centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 200)
  x[, cluster := factor(km_result$cluster)]
  centroids <- as.data.table(km_result$centers)
  setnames(centroids, c("centroid_UMAP1", "centroid_UMAP2"))
  centroids[, cluster := factor(seq_len(.N))]
  x[, dist_to_centroid := {
    center <- centroids[cluster == .BY$cluster]
    sqrt((UMAP1 - center$centroid_UMAP1)^2 + (UMAP2 - center$centroid_UMAP2)^2)
  }, by = cluster]
  medoid_reps <- x[, .SD[which.min(dist_to_centroid)], by = cluster]
  
  compounds_per_cluster <- ceiling(NUM.SELECT / k)
  diverse_selection <- x[, .SD[order(dist_to_centroid)][seq_len(min(.N, compounds_per_cluster))],
                                    by = cluster]
}
```

```{R do_this_with_morgan, eval=FALSE}
convert_to_fp_matrix <- function(x)
{
  mat_list <- lapply(x$fp_bit, 
                     function(s) as.integer(unlist(strsplit(s, ""))))
  mat <- do.call(rbind, mat_list)
  rownames(mat) <- x$cichem
  mat <- subset(mat,
                apply(mat, 1, function(x) !all(is.na(x))))
  return(mat)  
}

train.invitro <- convert_to_fp_matrix(subset(all.pipeline.morgan, cichem %in%
                          any.httk.meas$cichem))
target.invitro <- convert_to_fp_matrix(subset(all.pipeline.morgan, 
                         !(cichem %in% all.httk.allgoodqspr$cichem) & 
                          cichem %in% rocks.meas.targets))
train.logp <- convert_to_fp_matrix(subset(all.pipeline.morgan, cichem %in%
                    subset(rocks, dtxsid %in% opera.logp.training)$cichem))
target.logp <- convert_to_fp_matrix(subset(all.pipeline.morgan, 
                      !(cichem %in% rocks.opera.logP.withinAD$cichem) & 
                      cichem %in% rocks.meas.targets))
train.pka <- convert_to_fp_matrix(subset(all.pipeline.morgan, cichem %in%

                          cichem %in% rocks.meas.targets))

# luggage combination:
set.seed(12345)       
km_res <- kmeans(target.invitro,  centers = 20, nstart = 25)  

closest_chemical <- function(df1, df2, method = "Jaccard")
{
  # Compute the full distance matrix (rows = matrix1, cols = matrix2)
  library(proxy)
  dist_matrix<- as.matrix(proxy::dist(
    df1[,c("densmap_1","densmap_2")], 
    df2[,c("densmap_1","densmap_2")], 
    method = method))
  rownames(dist_matrix) <- df1$cichem
  colnames(dist_matrix) <- df2$cichem
  
  # Find the closest point in matrix2 for each row in matrix1
  pos <- apply(dist_matrix, 1, which.min)
  min_dist <- apply(dist_matrix, 1, min)
}

j3.invitro.target$InVitroDist <- signif(closest_chemical(j3.invitro.target, j3.invitro),3)
j3.logp.target$logPDist <- signif(closest_chemical(j3.logp.target, j3.logp),3)
j3.pka.target$pKaDist <- signif(closest_chemical(j3.pka.target, j3.pka),3)


j3.meastarget <- merge(j3.invitro.target, j3.logp.target, 
                       by=c("cichem", "primary_name"),
                       all.x=TRUE,
                       all.y=TRUE)
j3.meastarget <- merge(j3.meastarget, j3.pka.target, 
                       by=c("cichem", "primary_name"),
                       all.x=TRUE,
                       all.y=TRUE)

NUM.SELECT <- 300


target.rows <- unique(c(
  order(j3.meastarget$InVitroDist, decreasing=TRUE)[1:NUM.SELECT],
  order(j3.meastarget$logPDist, decreasing=TRUE)[1:NUM.SELECT],
  order(j3.meastarget$pKaDist, decreasing=TRUE)[1:NUM.SELECT]
  ))
target.chems <- j3.meastarget[target.rows,"cichem"]  

cat(paste0("The ", NUM.SELECT, " farthest (in the 2D projection) chemicals from the training sets for HTTK, logP, and pKa models in Fig X that also in classes where measurements have been successful are targets for future measurement to expand AD (", length(target.chems), " unique chemicals listed in Table SX). These \"measurement target\" chemicals are indicated in Fig X.\n"))

write.table(j3.meastarget[target.rows,
                          c("cichem","primary_name",
                            "densmap_1","densmap_2",
                            "InVitroDist","logPDist","pKaDist")],
            file="tables/SupTableX-TargetsForMeasurement.txt",
            row.names=FALSE,
          sep="\t")
```

```{r make_panel_c}
sector_cols <- c(
  "consumer",
  "industrial",
  "agricultural",
  "food",
  "pharmaceutical",
  "biomonitoring",
  "env_monitoring"
)

primary_sector_cols <- c(
  "consumer",
  "industrial",
  "agricultural",
  "food",
  "pharmaceutical"
)

fallback_sector_cols <- c(
  "biomonitoring",
  "env_monitoring"
)

sector_long <- landscape %>%
  select(cichem_id, TKCoverage, all_of(sector_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert the sector fields to explicit logical flags.
    # coalesce() prevents NA values from propagating.
    across(
      all_of(sector_cols),
      ~ coalesce(.x == TRUE | .x == 1, FALSE)
    ),

    has_primary_sector = if_any(
      all_of(primary_sector_cols),
      ~ .x
    ),

    has_biomonitoring = biomonitoring,
    has_env_monitoring = env_monitoring,

    # Fallback categories apply only when there is no primary sector.
    biomonitoring_unknown =
      !has_primary_sector & has_biomonitoring,

    env_monitoring_unknown =
      !has_primary_sector & has_env_monitoring,

    # True unknown means no primary or fallback annotation.
    unknown =
      !has_primary_sector &
      !has_biomonitoring &
      !has_env_monitoring
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      all_of(primary_sector_cols),
      biomonitoring_unknown,
      env_monitoring_unknown,
      unknown
    ),
    names_to = "sector",
    values_to = "in_sector_raw"
  ) %>%
  filter(in_sector_raw)

sector_long <- sector_long %>%
  mutate(
sector = recode(
  sector,
  consumer = "Consumer",
  industrial = "Industrial",
  agricultural = "Agricultural",
  food = "Food",
  pharmaceutical = "Pharmaceutical",
  biomonitoring_unknown = "Unknown\nBiomonitoring",
  env_monitoring_unknown = "Unknown\nEnv. monitoring",
  unknown = "Unknown"
)
  )

sector_counts <- sector_long %>%
  count(sector, TKCoverage, name = "n")

sector_order <- c(
  "Pharmaceutical",
  "Agricultural",
  "Food",
  "Consumer",
  "Industrial",
  "Unknown\nBiomonitoring",
  "Unknown\nEnv. monitoring",
  "Unknown"
)

sector_totals <- sector_long %>%
  count(sector, name = "total_n")

sector_totals <- sector_totals %>%
  mutate(
    sector = factor(sector, levels = sector_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sector) %>%
  mutate(
    sector_label = paste0(sector, " (n=", comma(total_n), ")")
  )

sector_counts <- sector_counts %>%
  left_join(sector_totals, by = "sector") %>%
  mutate(
    sector_label = factor(sector_label, levels = rev(sector_totals$sector_label))
    )

sector_plot_df <- sector_counts %>%
  group_by(sector_label) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = n / sum(n),
    pct_label = case_when(
      TKCoverage == "No TK Data" ~
        percent(pct, accuracy = 1),
      TKCoverage == "In Silico Predictions" ~
        percent(pct, accuracy = 1),
      TKCoverage == "Human Data" & pct > 0.05 ~
        percent(pct, accuracy = 1),
#      TKCoverage == "In Vivo Data" ~
#        as.character(paste0(signif(pct*100, 1),"%")),
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


#test
assessment_labels <- sector_plot_df %>%
  filter(TKCoverage  == "Human Data") %>%
  mutate(
    label_y = c(
      1.03,  # Ag
      1.03,  # 
      1.03,  # Food
      1.03,  # Consumer
      1.03,  # Pharm
      1.07,  # Biomonitoring
      1.06   # Env monitoring
    )
  )

p_sector <- ggplot(

  aes(x = sector_label, y = pct, fill = TKCoverage)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.75,

    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # Labels inside the bars:

    aes(

    ),

  ) +

  coord_flip(clip = "off") +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1.15),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

 scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
  "No TK Data"=UL.cols[3],
  "Human Data"=UL.cols[2],
  "Animal Data"=UL.cols[5],
  "In Vitro Data"=UL.cols[4],

  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
```

### Chemical class analysis
```{r chem_class_text}
# Find first noTk.class not in top of TK class:
  TK.class <- rocks.TK.prevalence$class[1:20]
  TK.class <- TK.class[TK.class!=""]
  noTK.class <- rocks.noTK.prevalence$class[1:20]
  noTK.class <- noTK.class[noTK.class!=""]
  
  this.index <- 1
  while(all(noTK.class[1:this.index] %in% TK.class[1:this.index]) |
        all(noTK.class[1:(this.index+1)] %in% TK.class[1:(this.index+1)]))
  {
    this.index <- this.index + 1
  }
  class.dif <- this.index
  most.common.classes <- TK.class[1:(class.dif-1)]
cat(paste0("TThe most prevalent chemical classes in order were: ",
    paste(TK.class[1:(class.dif-1)],collapse=", "),
    ".\n"))

cat(paste0("\nThe next most prevalent classes for chemicals with TK predictions were: ",
           paste(unlist(
             TK.class[class.dif:(class.dif+2)]),collapse=", "),
           "while the next classes among the chemicals with no TK predictions were: ",
           paste(unlist(
             noTK.class[class.dif:(class.dif+2)]),collapse=", "),
           ".\n"))

cat(paste0("\nThere are ",
           dim(rocks.noTK.prevalence)[1] - dim(rocks.TK.prevalence)[1],
           " more classes present among the chemicals with no TK predictions (see Supplemental Table X).\n"))
missing.TK.prevalance <- subset(rocks.noTK.prevalence,
                               !(class %in% rocks.TK.prevalence$class))

cat(paste0("\nThe most prevalent classes that do not have any HTTK predictions were: ",
           paste(unlist(
             subset(rocks.noTK.prevalence, !(class %in% rocks.TK.prevalence$class))[1:5,"class"]),collapse=", ")))

cat(paste0("\nThe most prevalent classes that do not have any HTTK predictions were various classes of metallic compounds. The TK of metals may be very different from the organic and PFAS chemicals covered by the QSPRs [KENTUCKY REF].\n"))
```

### Half-life stats
```{r text_for_halflife}
  hl.invivo <- subset(hl.data, Type == "In Vivo" & 
                        tolower(Species)=="human" &
                        is.finite(as.numeric(Value)))
  min.row <- which(as.numeric(hl.invivo$Value) == 
                     min(as.numeric(hl.invivo$Value), na.rm=TRUE))
  if (hl.invivo[min.row, "Units"] == "hours") 
  {
    cat(paste0(hl.invivo[min.row, "Compound"],
        " has a half life of ",
        signif(as.numeric(hl.invivo[min.row, "Value"])*60, 2),
        " minutes (",
        query_reference(hl.invivo[min.row,"ref_id_fk"])$Reference,
        ")\n"
        ))
    cat(paste0(hl.invivo[min.row, "Compound"],
        " has a half life of ",
        signif(as.numeric(hl.invivo[min.row, "Value"])*60*60, 2),
        " seconds (",
        query_reference(hl.invivo[min.row,"ref_id_fk"])$Reference,
        ")\n"
        ))
  }
  max.row <- which(as.numeric(hl.invivo$Value) == 
                     max(as.numeric(hl.invivo$Value), na.rm=TRUE))
  if (all(hl.invivo[max.row, "Units"] == "hours"))
  {
    cat(paste0(hl.invivo[max.row, "Compound"],
               " has a half life of ",
               signif(as.numeric(hl.invivo[max.row, "Value"])/24/365, 2),
               " years (",
               query_reference(hl.invivo[max.row,"ref_id_fk"])$Reference,
               ")\n"
    ))
  }
  
  cat("The in vivo half-lives span",
      signif(log10(as.numeric(hl.invivo[max.row, "Value"]) /
                     as.numeric(hl.invivo[min.row, "Value"])), 1),
      "orders of magnitude.")
```

```{r tk_stats_text}
cat(paste0("\nThere are ",
           hl.quant.frac[hl.quant.frac$Quant.Prob==first.over.1000,"Num.Obs"],
           " chemicals in the upper ",
           signif(first.over.1000*100,3),
           "% quantile with measured human in vivo half-lives of ",
           format(signif(hl.quant.frac[hl.quant.frac$Quant.Prob==first.over.1000,
                                       "Obs.Quant"], PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS), 
                  big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),

cat(paste0("\nFor these chemicals, HTTK based on QSPRs predicts that the ",
           "half-life would be more than 1000 h for ",

                                "FRAC.Over1000"]*100, PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
           "%.\n"))

cat(paste0("\nHowever, HTTK predictions are conservative, and only ",
           signif(sum(hl.predgt1000$Observed>1000)/nrow(hl.predgt1000)*100,
       PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
       "% of chemicals predicted to have half-lives greater than 1000 h actually had such half-lives.\n"))

                                            "Model", "Type", "Species",

            sep="\t",
            row.names=FALSE)

           length(unique(pred.over.1000$cichem)),
           " chemicals predicted to have half-lives over 1000 h, as given in Table SX.\n"))

max.1000 <- max(subset(hl.quant.frac, Quant.Prob > first.over.1000)$FRAC.Over1000)
cat(paste0("\nAs we look to higher quantiles ...  half-life ranges from ",
           signif(min.1000*100,
                  PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
           "% to ",
           signif(max.1000*100,
                  PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
           "% (see Table S9, Supporting Information).\n"))

min.short <- min(subset(hl.quant.frac, Quant.Prob < first.over.1000)$Frac.Tenfold)
max.short <- max(subset(hl.quant.frac, Quant.Prob < first.over.1000)$Frac.Tenfold)
cat(paste0("\nFor chemicals with half-lives less than ... factor of ten ranges from ",
           signif(min.short*100,
                  PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
           "% to ",
           signif(max.short*100,
                  PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
```

```{r other_tk_stats_text}
                  PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
           "% in Table 2.\n"))


```


### Implications for Chemical Risk

### Half-life and chemical use
```{r halflife_and_use_text}
  max.hl <- subset(hl.invivo.data, Bin %in% c(max(hl.invivo.data$Bin),
                                              max(hl.invivo.data$Bin)-1,
                                              max(hl.invivo.data$Bin)-2))
  num.max <- nrow(max.hl)
  cat(paste0("On the far right of Figure 5, a total of ",
    num.max," with the longest half-lives (>",
             signif(unlist(BinLeft)[length(BinLeft)-2]/24/365,2),
      " years) are represented..\n"))
  
  cat(paste0(sum(max.hl$biomonitoring),
             " of these ",
             num.max,
            " chemicals have been detected in human biomonitoring. [REF ISAACS]\n"))
  
  cat(paste0("The chemical among the longest half-lives with pharmaceutical use is ",
             subset(max.hl, pharmaceutical==1)$Compound,
             ".\n"))
  cat(paste0("The chemicals among the longest half-lives and food use are ",
             paste(subset(max.hl, food==1)$Compound, collapse=" and "),
             ".\n"))
```

```{r implications_css}
cat("\nCss is the key TK parameter for the incorporation of data from toxicological NAMs into chemical risk assessment.")
cat(paste0(signif(subset(tkstats.table, Parameter %in% c("Css"))$Within.Ten*100,
                  PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
           "% of predictions fall within ten-fold of in vivo estimates, while ",
           signif(subset(tkstats.table, Parameter %in% c("Css"))$Within.Three*100,
                  PERCENTILE.SIG.FIGS),
           "% fall within three-fold.\n"))
```

### Uncertainty/Variability Ratios
```{r uncertainty_analysis_text}
cat(paste0("\nis approximately log-normally distributed with a mean of ",
           signif(mean(subset(css.uf.table,Ratio.Type=="Uncertainty")$Ratio),2),
           ".\n"))
cat(paste0("\nis approximately log-normally distributed with a mean of ",
           signif(mean(subset(css.uf.table,Ratio.Type=="Variability")$Ratio),2),
           ".\n"))
uf.var <- subset(css.uf.table, Ratio.Type =="Variability")
ratio.max.row <- which(uf.var$Ratio == max(uf.var$Ratio))
ratio.max.id <- uf.var[which(uf.var$Ratio == max(uf.var$Ratio)), "chem_id_fk"]
cat(paste0("\nwith some chemicals having much larger ratios (maximum ",
  signif(uf.var[ratio.max.row,"Ratio"],3),
           " for ",
  subset(chem.physical_and_invitro.data$synonyms,
       chem_id_fk==ratio.max.id)$synonym_formal,
       ").\n"))
```
